static_traits.name: 张志成
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without类似心理问题史；not yet接受过其他心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能进行自我Reflection；常用“应该/必须”的评价性语言；倾向Self-denial和内疚；对证据检视持开放态度，配合度Good

basic_info.main_problem: 当因下雨等天气原因without法带狗进行长时间散步时，张志成会反复产生“我是个差劲的狗主人”的想法，伴随明显的内疚与not足感，影响情绪与日常生活。
basic_info.core_demands: 因without法进行长时间遛狗而引发的内疚与not足感已影响整体情绪与幸福感，希望通过咨询减轻这些情绪、改善自我评价。
growth_experiences: 约一年前雨季开始后，因天气限制without法维持既往“长时间遛狗”的固定日程，开始反复自责为“差劲的狗主人”，内疚与not足感逐渐加重；其自我标准较高，认为作为负责任的宠物主人应始终做到最好。

core_beliefs: 只有完美地履行责任才算有价值
如果have not达到自己的高标准，我就是失败的/not称职的

special_situations.event: 下雨或天气恶劣，without法带狗进行长时间散步
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一个好主人应该not受天气影响也能完成长时间遛狗
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 自我苛责与Reinforcement自我监督；在可行时更严格要求自己维持长时间遛狗；尝试用自我安慰与现实检验说服自己但常被negate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am letting my dog down / I am a terrible dog owner

special_situations.event: 天气并not理想但并非特do not恶劣时，仍not yet进行长时间遛狗
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要have not完成长时间遛狗，就等于失败，without论理由是否正当
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视其他照顾行为（如室内互动、短时散步）的价值，继续聚焦“not yet长走”的not足
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 短时间或室内活动都not算数

special_situations.event: Invited to assess actual care beyond long dog walks (such as diet, companionship, health management)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only long dog walks are the key standard for measuring a good owner; other aspects have limited value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Uses 'should/must' to maintain strict standards, devaluing alternatives and existing positive evidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These are all excuses; a truly good owner would find a way to complete the long walk

special_situations.event: 想到向朋友倾诉内疚与not足感时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 这种困扰太琐碎，not应该麻烦朋友；说出来会被认为小题大做
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids seeking help and expressing; bears it alone and continues self-monitoring
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得这很without聊/我not该打扰他们

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a 'responsible caregiver', convinced she is good enough
core_conflict.fear: 害怕成为not称职的主人、辜负所爱（宠物），由此感到羞耻与失去价值
defense_goal: 通过维持严格标准与自我苛责来获得控制感并缓解not确定性
将对not可控情境（天气）的挫败转向自我以避免对外归因带来的without力感

object_relations.self_representation: 永远not够好的、容易失职的照料者
object_relations.object_representation: An internalized picky judge of the 'ideal master / external standards'

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当外界条件（如下雨）使其without法完成长时间遛狗，或当咨询师提出替代方案与更全面证据时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将现实限制理解为自己not够努力/not够好，把他人的支持性建议体验为在找借口
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以自责与苛刻的“应该”语言回应，强调自身not足，弱化外界限制与替代方案的合理性。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to examine the overall evidence of care beyond long dog-walking (diet, companionship, health)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为只有达到某一绝对标准才算合格，其余证据not具决定性
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use抽象规则与原则性用语（如“应该/必须”），淡化情绪体验，语气克制，围绕标准进行辩驳。

manifestations: 将责任理解为必须“总是尽全力”，对not可控自然限制（天气）缺乏接纳
用僵化标准定义自我价值，将个体Freedom与现实限制之间的张力体验为内疚
outcomes: Low mood并影响日常作息与幸福感
Avoids seeking help from the support system, bears stress alone

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 反复use“好主人应该总是想办法完成长时间遛狗”的自我要求
将替代性照料（室内游戏、短时散步）视为“not够好/借口”

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 强烈自责（“我是个差劲的主人”），Reinforcement自我监督以达成严格标准
Believes his troubles are 'too trivial', avoids asking friends for help

positive_force: Has a stable care schedule for pets and a high sense of responsibility
The pet is mostly happy and energetic, suggesting the actual quality of care is good
愿意进行现实检验与收集证据，合作意愿Good
Has a supportive network of friends（尽管尚not yet启用）
negative_force: 个人化与心理过滤倾向，negate积极证据
Self-denial与内疚主导的自我评价，降低情绪与日常功能
对求助的回避（认为问题琐碎而not打扰朋友）
外部not可控因素（天气）trigger稳定的负性自动思维

target_behavior.behavior: 在without法进行长时间遛狗时出现的强烈内疚与自我贬责（负性自我言语如“我是个差劲的主人”）
antecedent: 下雨/恶劣天气导致without法长时间散步
not yet达成既定“长时间遛狗”的日程
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizes 'walking the dog for a long time' as the sole key standard for measuring a good owner, lacking acceptance of practical constraints
target_behavior.function: Self-monitoring and maintaining high standards (trying to promote behavior meeting standards through self-blame, gaining a sense of control)
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood与内疚加重，影响日常作息与整体幸福感

target_behavior.behavior: 回避向朋友表达与寻求支持（认为困扰太琐碎not该打扰他人）
antecedent: 想到与朋友谈及因not能长时间遛狗而产生的内疚时
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjection的价值条件与自我苛责，认为弱化标准或表达脆弱是not应当的
target_behavior.function: Avoids possible evaluation and exposure of vulnerability, maintaining self-image and a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Emotional distress lacks external support and buffering, the negative cycle is maintained
